optimizedDescription.value: Conservative deterministic symbol resolution across canonical ids, qualified names, declarations, bindings, aliases, and hierarchies.

optimizedContext.value:
# resolve-symbol-reference
## Rules
- `ResolveSymbolReference` input: workspace, text; optional file, public surface, symbol-space, broad kind, member-semantics, owner, build-context. Structured fields authoritative; canonical rendering round-trips with escaping, never ad hoc delimiter splitting. `MemberForm` is not input.
- `Tipo.miembro`/`Tipo::miembro`: equality on stored `qualified_name`; `::` compares dotted spelling. Requires no file/surface/language; never run all adapters or default one. Return every match; one resolves. Supplied file/surface filters visibility; none remaining => unresolved.
- Other owner-qualified human text uses adapter proven by explicit language, anchored indexed-file language, then indexed public-surface metadata. No proven adapter => unresolved. Language controls identifier case/normalization; path/workspace normalization separate.
- Canonical target is one logical symbol retaining all declaration occurrences. Language overload/merge equivalents remain one; genuine competitors separate. Expose workspace, module/package, owner, symbol space, simple name, member form, locations, stable line/column-independent canonical reference.
- Public slot identity: surface + exported name + symbol space; each route independently addressable by target/ordered re-export provenance. Preserve aliases, duplicate routes, competing targets for ambiguity. Local binding retains lexical scope/source range; shadowing does not merge; local alias is not public export. Anonymous/default exports addressable by public binding.
- Resolution precedence: (1) exact current canonical logical id; (2) stored `qualified_name` equality for dotted/`::`, all equals; (3) exact declaration in addressed file/owner; (4) exact binding in addressed public surface; (5) proven scoped import/alias; (6) proven language hierarchy path.
- Owner-qualified resolution proves owner path then member; never terminal-name search plus ranked owner inference. Same-name without proven path cannot resolve. Build context may select conditional/platform alternative; otherwise alternatives remain. Cycles terminate without duplicate candidates. Public binding requires surface + export + symbol space; file alone cannot select; target may cross workspace.
- Exactly one status: `resolved` one proven logical target; `ambiguous` multiple valid targets; `unresolved` unsafe/unavailable proof; `missing` only current complete index proves addressed absence. Non-resolved includes stable reason and ordered candidates; all results expose ordered typed evidence paths.
- Freshness uses one deduplicated batch `AssessIndexedResourceFreshness` for addressed resources and every contributing declaration file; public surface is addressed resource when no source file. Resolver performs no filesystem/repository/hash/persistence work. VCS equality alone insufficient.
- Current exact file evidence may resolve despite unrelated global staleness. Workspace-wide fallback/absence/uniqueness/ambiguity needing completeness stays unresolved when global stale/unknown.
- Unknown/dirty/stale/incompatible/excluded/unsupported/parse-failed/partial required evidence => specific unresolved, never missing; transient assessment => `freshness-unknown`. Current complete addressed file/public surface can prove missing without persisting symbol staleness. Provider/generation unreadability remains infrastructure error.
- Declared/overriding member precedes inherited. Contract-qualified resolves contract member; impact may follow implementations/overrides. Inheritance, trait, mixin, embedding, promotion, abstract/default members obey deterministic language precedence.
- Ancestor traversal queries requested member under ancestor, never treats owner as member; evidence retains owner-to-ancestor path plus selected declaration. Competing inherited members => ambiguous. Same-name getter/setter forms require member-semantics constraint when language cannot select. Implicit interface requires proven method set. Cycles bounded.
- Batch resolution shares health snapshot/provider lifecycle; indexed bounded cycle-safe lookups, no full-graph scan per request. Candidate/provenance ordering, status, reasons backend-independent.
## Constraints
- Never mutate stored links or archived sidecars.
- No fuzzy matching, edit distance, best-candidate guessing.
- Runtime reflection, computed imports, monkey patching, unproven interprocedural value flow remain unresolved.
- Adapter-specific syntax analysis belongs to language adapters.
